hull_geometry: Elongated, rectangular main hull with significant lateral outcroppings for weapon systems; blocky, modular construction with exposed radiator fins
materials_and_finish: Heavy, reinforced plating with visible welding seams and structural ribbing; numerous small sensor apertures and point-defense mounts
design_philosophy: Prioritizes utility and durability over aesthetics; resembles a deep-sea submersible or a heavily armored ocean-going vessel
color_scheme: Dull slate grey with dark blue digital camouflage patterns; minimal lighting except for small red status indicators along the hull
distinctive_traits: Massive exposed structural elements suggest a focus on modular repair and field maintenance
